rubrics.justification: The response is only partially visible and gives a generally plausible high-quality blastocyst description, but it overstates image-specific detail (e.g., exact ICM clock position, estimated >50 cells, distinct cell borders) that may not be reliably supported from a single image. It also does not complete the zona/blastocoel assessment.
The visible response does not integrate the provided patient factors with embryo quality; it focuses only on morphology before being cut off.
What is shown is internally consistent, but the reasoning chain is incomplete and does not reach prognosis, risk assessment, or probability estimation.

The visible morphology language is broadly consistent with Gardner grading concepts, but the incomplete response prevents assessment of whether recommendations and prognosis align with IVF guidelines.
No practical transfer recommendations, future cycle planning, or clear next steps are present in the visible response.
